gov_subpath_1_detection_finding.summary: GOV-SUBPATH-1 flagged all four drivers on a PACKAGE-PARENT import, not a direct import of tonic_vigor. None of the four drivers directly imports ree_core.policy.tonic_vigor or sets use_tonic_vigor. gov_subpath_1_detection_finding.mechanism: REE_assembly/scripts/check_substrate_path_overlap.py:301-310 _modules_overlap() returns True when target.startswith(imp + '.'). resolve_driver_imports() adds the bare module of every from-import, so `from ree_core.policy import ChunkedPrimitive` (844:207, 904:90, 919:188) or `from ree_core.policy import NoiseFloor` (544a:71) yields 'ree_core.policy', and 'ree_core.policy.tonic_vigor'.startswith('ree_core.policy.') matches. Every driver importing ANY name from the ree_core.policy package is reported as a tonic_vigor importer.
gov_subpath_1_detection_finding.second_defect: The audit's 'scoring' classification read evidence_direction only: v3_exq_544a carries scoring_excluded=diagnostic_probe on both its claim_evidence rows (MECH-313, ARC-065) and weights nothing (already established by failure_autopsy_substrate-readiness-cluster_2026-09-02). gov_subpath_1_detection_finding.better_signal: Import is not enablement. The defect executes only when use_tonic_vigor=True; the manifest's config / enabled_default_off_flags and the driver's config construction are the direct signal.

targets.defect_exposure_basis: Driver sets only decomposition_use_harm_aware_selection + 5 harm-bias params; no use_tonic_vigor / dacc / lateral_pfc / ofc / curiosity flag, so the MECH-320 defect GFLAG-0403 names is absent. HOWEVER both stages consume the SAME per-leaf harm_penalty (hippocampal/module.py:1263-1275: leaves_with_penalty -> Stage 1 harm_bias metadata AND Stage 2 select_harm_aware_leaves), read by _decomposition_harm_penalty (module.py:1128) off each leaf's own e2.rollout_with_world predicted states. If per-leaf predictions collapse, Stage 1 is a near-constant additive offset and Stage 2's argmin is a tie that keeps items[0] -- a harm-BLIND pool cut. Stage 2 fired on 6831 of 6977 decompositions (97.9%), so 'the treatment moved behaviour' (ON-vs-OFF action divergence mean 0.419, recomputed twice) cannot discriminate harm-informed from harm-blind selection. [Withdrawn from the first draft: 'Stage 2 is categorical pool admission and cannot be drowned' -- false, it consumes the same penalty; and the inference 'behaviour moved, therefore not a defect artifact' -- a non-sequitur for this exposure. Red-team (fable) finding B1, confirmed by source read.] Countervailing evidence that the collapse was NOT live in August: contemporaneous trained-agent runs record nonzero per-candidate spread -- consumed_summary_pairwise_dist_mean 0.080-0.095 (847/847a/851/858, other cells 0.021-0.158), cand_world_pairwise_dist_mean 0.124 (925, other cells 0.024-0.157) -- versus 0.0000 in the May untrained-agent measurement; some cells sit below the 0.05 GAP-A floor. These are different drivers/configs, so they bound but do not measure 919's regime. No run in the 867/867a/867b/919 lineage recorded per-leaf harm_penalty spread or the Stage-2 argmin tie rate.
